jobs.title: Operations Manager, Ground Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEHO

 

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone. 

 

We are building a modern, end-to-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers.  

 

Powered by next-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post-purchase experience. We make delivery the ‘extension of the brand’ and leverage it to create deeper loyalty and trust between brands and their customers, driving customer retention and lifetime value. Our rapidly growing client list includes leading consumer brands like HelloFresh, Zara, Macy’s, Sephora, and more.

 

To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit-based culture. We seek team players who want to compete, win, make an impact and build a legacy, and we reward performance and impact players with generous equity and incredible career growth opportunities. 



Compensation:

$90,000 - $105,000 annually

The pay range is subject to the discretion of the Company. Additionally, Veho offers a competitive equity package, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited PTO for exempt level roles.

 

Role Summary:

As the site leader, the Operations Manager, you will play a vital role in the overall success of the warehouse facility by leading employee activity to achieve performance goals. You will be responsible for overseeing facility sort and driver launch operations while coaching, mentoring, and directing supervisors and associates to hit key KPIs and OKRs. You will also be responsible for managing the operation’s P&L, leading logistics oversight, and focusing on process improvement. Additionally, you will ensure safety in the warehouse, including being a champion of OSHA compliance and appropriate reporting.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 - Build a high-performing team of supervisors and associates to deliver an advanced level of quality, speed, and service in all daily activities

 - Coach, train, and guide supervisors and associates for forwarding career progression

 - Use data and collaborate with the direct reports to identify and execute process improvements for the operation

 - Generate programs and practices that deliver a high level of customer satisfaction, on-time delivery success, and safety

 - Create, foster, and maintain strategic relationships within the Market, Region, and Central Operations teams

 - Partner with our Client Operations team to exceed client expectations as their last-mile delivery partner

 - Champion OSHA compliance and track incidents within markets

 - Lead through the lens of Veho's Values

 - Work cross-functionally to hire, retain, coach, and develop employees within the operation

 - Lead efforts to significantly impact efficiencies and scalability in WH operations (i.e. automated sortation implementation) as well as managing increased complexity at the market level (hub to spoke, master sort facilities, high volume facilities)

 

What you Bring:

 - Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university, or 3-5 years experience in warehouse operations management

 - Minimum of 2 years leading and managing a team of direct and indirect reports

 - 3+ years of experience in warehousing, inventory, or logistics

 - Flexibility, innovation, and the ability to manage staff, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, and time-critical environment

 - Ability to effectively respond to and interact with staff at all levels of the organization

 - Excellent written/oral communication skills

 - Intermediate analytical skills--experience with Excel/Google Sheets

 - Is physically able to stand for the duration of the shift, move boxes up and down, including bending and frequently lifting (up to 50 lbs required)

 - Willingness to work flexible schedules, including weekends, holidays, and evenings

 

Veho is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. No matter the location, or the role, every Veho teammate shares one galvanizing mission: driving commerce forward with a customer-centric delivery experience that's built for the modern era. We live by our leadership principles. We're looking for team members who are: obsessed over the customer, first-principles thinkers, builders at heart, intrinsically driven to win, and owners biased toward action.

 

Join us in building the future of ecommerce logistics and in doing the work of our lifetime!

 

All California applicants, please reference our California Applicant Privacy Notice located here https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yvI9KKjVm6YUurqLi_LTQtdh7d0J7Lrd/view?usp=sharing.



The pay range is subject to the discretion of the Company. Additionally, Veho offers a competitive equity package, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and other benefits such as a 401 (k) and unlimited PTO for exempt-level roles.

jobs.description:
ABOUT VEHO

 

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone.

To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit-based culture. We seek team players who want to compete, win, make an impact and build a legacy, and we reward performance and impact players with generous equity and incredible career growth opportunities. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Leader for our Business Operations team to be Veho's internal execution engine. This person owns two interconnected things: the operating rhythm that keeps the company aligned on its priorities, and the ability to lead high-priority cross-functional efforts that do not have a natural home.



On the planning side, this means owning the OKR and business planning cadence end to end, making sure leaders are aligned on short-, mid-, and long-term priorities, that planning cycles are sequenced and clear, and that the operating rhythm is reliable and scalable. On the cross-functional side, this means standing up tiger teams, small groups assembled to attack high-priority problems that span functions and lack a clear owner, diagnosing root causes from first principles, and driving durable fixes with speed.



What makes this role hard and interesting is the combination. It takes discipline to run a reliable planning machine and a completely different gear to drop into unfamiliar territory, earn trust without authority, and drive a solution with urgency. This is a builder-operator role, not a coordinator role. You will start as a solo operator and grow the function as the scope earns it.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

OKR & Business Planning

 - Own the end-to-end OKR process: drafting, leadership alignment, quarterly tracking, and keeping team goals connected to company priorities.

 - Run the planning cadence: sequence short-, mid-, and long-term planning cycles, define inputs and outputs, and keep the process on track.

 - Build operating infrastructure: create the templates, trackers, and dashboards that make the planning rhythm repeatable and not dependent on heroics.

 - Drive decisions, not just process: produce pre-reads and decision-forcing content that help senior leaders align quickly and leave the room with clear owners and next steps.

 - Serve as a trusted partner to leadership: turn ambiguous priorities into actionable plans that people actually execute, and messy operational data into key insights leadership actually needs to act on.

Tiger Teams & Cross-Functional Execution

 - Stand up and lead tiger teams on high-priority cross-functional problems that span functions and lack a clear owner. Define the scope, align on what done looks like, and drive to a resolution.

 - Diagnose from first principles: go to where the work actually happens- the warehouse, the route, the dock, the raw data- to find root causes rather than relying on second-hand reports.

 - Run the workplan: define milestones, assign owners, run the cadence, and clear blockers with urgency.

 - Land the fix: hand off a durable solution to a permanent owner so the problem stays solved and the value is captured.

 - Build stakeholder relationships: earn influence through competence and follow-through, not title. Surface problems and bad news early.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Experience

 - 8+ years of total experience, with a strong foundation in management consulting and a meaningful chapter in Strategy & Operations or BizOps at a high-growth company.

 - A demonstrated track record of driving concrete operational outcomes, not just producing analysis or recommendations.

 - Hands-on experience owning a planning or OKR process, or a clear analog.

 - Fluency using AI tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, and execution.

 - Experience at a company with physical or logistical operations (logistics, supply chain, marketplaces, on-demand) is a plus.

How You Work

 - Process builder: you productize everything. You turn a one-off effort into a repeatable system, then optimize it. You build infrastructure that scales without you.

 - First-principles problem solver: you break unfamiliar problems down to their fundamentals and reason backward from the outcome. You do not pattern-match to how it was done somewhere else.

 - Clear communicator: your pre-reads and recommendations make it easy for busy leaders to decide. You simplify without making things simplistic.

 - Analytically rigorous: the language of your decisions is data and logic. You are comfortable building models, dashboards, and KPI frameworks.

 - Strong cross-functional operator: you earn influence through competence and follow-through. You drive outcomes through teams you do not own.

 - Bias toward action: you operate with urgency and make calls with imperfect information, then adjust in motion.

 - Willing to get your hands dirty: you know the right answer lives where the work happens, not in a deck. You go to the front line.

No matter the location, or the role, every Veho teammate shares one galvanizing mission: driving commerce forward with a customer-centric delivery experience that's built for the modern era. We live by our leadership principles. We're looking for team members who are: obsessed over the customer, first-principles thinkers, builders at heart, intrinsically driven to win, and owners biased toward action.

 

Join us in building the future of ecommerce logistics and in doing the work of our lifetime!

jobs.description:

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone.

To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit-based culture. We seek team players who want to compete, win, make an impact and build a legacy, and we reward performance and impact players with generous equity and incredible career growth opportunities. 


ROLE PURPOSE

The Expansion Strategy & Operations Manager owns the analytical and problem-solving backbone behind Veho's plan to reach nationwide population coverage. This role exists because rapid expansion is fundamentally a strategy-and-analytics problem before it is an execution problem — someone has to build the data and forecasting infrastructure that expansion decisions rest on, diagnose why actuals diverge from plan, and turn messy, incomplete information into a defensible point of view about where and when Veho should grow.

The cross-functional coordination across Commercial, Network, Product, Real Estate/3PL, Driver Marketplace, Program Management, and Ground Operations is the delivery mechanism, not the job itself. As the business grows, so does the runbook: this person builds and evolves the forecasting models, the reporting systems, and the readiness frameworks for new challenges in a domain where the right answer is genuinely ambiguous — the job demands conviction, flexibility, and the ability to go from 0 to 1 and then 1 to 100.


IDEAL CANDIDATE ARCHETYPE


SKILLSET

 - Analytics & Forecasting Ownership: Can own a forecast-to-actual reconciliation process end-to-end — building the data pipeline, identifying root causes when reality diverges from prediction, and designing interventions that actually stick. A build-it-yourself capability, not oversight of someone else's model.

 - SQL & AI-Tool Proficiency: Comfortable working directly in the data and using AI tools to move faster — writing the queries, structuring the datasets, and pressure-testing the numbers personally.

 - Structured Problem-Solving Under Ambiguity: Takes an open-ended, poorly-defined question ("should we launch this market, and when?") and structures it into a defensible, data-backed recommendation — comfortable making calls with incomplete information and explicit about what's validated versus a bet.

 - 0-to-1 Building: Has built forecasting models, reporting systems, or operating frameworks from scratch without an established playbook — creates the system rather than inheriting and maintaining one.

 - Single-Source-of-Truth Reporting: Track record building a dashboard or reporting structure that non-technical stakeholders actually use — translating messy operational data into KPIs that force visibility and accountability.

 - Multi-Function Fluency: Comfortable operating across seven functional areas simultaneously with clear judgment about what requires consensus versus what can be driven unilaterally.

 - Physical Network Systems Thinking: Familiarity with physical network constraint problems — able to model hub placement, final-mile economics, labor availability, and real-estate timelines as one integrated system.


LEADERSHIP TRAITS

 - First-Principles Problem Solver: Investigates performance gaps by first asking "what changed?" — comfortable at both the high level and the nitty-gritty to find root cause rather than assuming the original plan was right.

 - Thrives in Ambiguity: Energized rather than paralyzed by open-ended problems and missing data; builds structure where none exists instead of waiting for a defined brief.

 - Radical Transparency on Confidence: Explicitly calls out which assumptions are validated versus bets, and updates stakeholders as confidence shifts rather than defending original projections.

 - Dependency Mapping Before Execution: Identifies critical-path dependencies across functions before they become bottlenecks rather than discovering blockers mid-execution.

 - Builds Institutional Memory: Documents what worked from each launch rather than treating each expansion as a one-off.

 - Pushes Authority to the Work: Moves decision-making toward the people closest to the problem rather than imposing a top-down solution.

 - Moves with Velocity: Thrives in a fast-paced environment and shifts priorities based on new insights and business needs.


EXPERIENCE

Must Have

 - Minimum 7 years of experience heavily weighted toward strategy, analytics, and problem-solving — not primarily operational execution or program coordination

 - Proven ability to conduct analysis independently and translate it into clear, actionable recommendations

 - Proficiency in SQL and AI tools; comfortable in the data directly

 - Track record of building something new (a model, a reporting system, a framework) from scratch in an ambiguous, high-growth environment

 - Experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives using project-management best practices

 - Thinks critically about problems and priorities and challenges the status quo

Good to Have

 - Background in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a strategy-and-operations (BizOps / Strategy & Ops) function at a high-growth tech-enabled company

 - Exposure to logistics, supply chain, marketplace, or physical-network businesses

 - Experience with volume forecasting, demand planning, or capacity modeling

jobs.title: Director of Talent Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEHO

 

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone. 

 

We are building a modern, end-to-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers.  

 

Powered by next-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post-purchase experience. We make delivery the ‘extension of the brand’ and leverage it to create deeper loyalty and trust between brands and their customers, driving customer retention and lifetime value. Our rapidly growing client list includes leading consumer brands like HelloFresh, Zara, Macy’s, Sephora, and more.

 

To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit-based culture. We seek team players who want to compete, win, make an impact and build a legacy, and we reward performance and impact players with generous equity and incredible career growth opportunities. 


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

We’re a lean team with a deep understanding of the business. We prioritize speed and quality. We hold a high bar. In 2026, we’re chasing scale aggressively - building new products, resilient systems, a Championship team and world-class operational processes. Our edge isn’t just our obsession with using technology to make shipping the most important part of the commerce experience, it’s our talent. Technology and systems can be copied, talent cannot. If Veho can build and retain the highest performing team in the industry, we will win. And as we scale, we need to ensure that our investments in people translate into measurable business impact and sustainable growth.



You will connect how we hire with how we develop people, so that top talent enters, grows rapidly, and raises the performance of everyone around them - always connecting our people investments to business outcomes and ROI. High performers want to work with other high performers, and every internal program either strengthens that standard or lowers it. Your job is to decide and build the key programs needed to attract, keep, and elevate top-tier talent at Veho, in the order they matter most. Exceptional work will be clearly recognized and rewarded, while underperformance will be identified and addressed in weeks rather than quarters. You will directly manage the systems and operations that power this: Total Rewards, Employee Experience, Performance Management, People Systems & AI, and People Analytics.



Our Talent Acquisition and People Business Partners teams will be key partners to successfully execute the strategies and systems you develop. You will lead a core team of roughly six people while shaping the team’s structure over time. This is a hands-on, player-coach role: you will need a clear philosophy on talent standards and the willingness to build the programs yourself.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Talent Quality & Roadmap: Set the priority list for what we build, when, and why. Define clear ways to measure team quality across functions, identify performance gaps honestly, and execute plans to fix them.

 - Hiring-to-Development Loop: In partnership with our Head of Talent Acquisition, track the quality of new hires, turn onboarding and the first 90 days into an accurate assessment window, and share direct candidate feedback back with your partners in Talent Acquisition to refine our recruiting focus.

 - Performance & Manager Growth: Design performance reviews, calibration sessions, and clear performance standards. Partner with the People Business Partner team to impelent these, and train managers to spot top performers, challenge them with growth opportunities, and address underperformance early. Success is measured by actual changes in manager behavior, not training completion rates.

 - Total Rewards: Finalize and maintain our compensation structure, job levels, pay bands, market benchmarking, and merit/promotion guidelines. Oversee employee benefits strategy and vendor management (a compensation specialist will assist with technical execution).

 - Systems, AI & Analytics: Manage our HRIS, data integrations, and data accuracy. Build the central metric dashboards used by executive leadership, and actively implement AI and automation to eliminate repetitive, manual HR tasks.

 - Team Leadership: Direct a team of approximately six people across Total Rewards, Employee Experience, People Systems, AI, and Analytics. Handle team design, set operational standards, and work directly alongside your team.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

 - Optimized Team Structure: Your team is structured efficiently, setting a high standard of execution before asking other departments to raise theirs.

 - Reliable Data & Reporting: Leadership relies on accurate, trustworthy People metrics that are delivered consistently in monthly business reviews.

 - Clear Performance Standards: Managers use a shared language for performance, resolving mediocre performance within weeks rather than months.

 - Targeted Retention for Top Talent: High performers are systematically identified and retained through clear career progression, competitive compensation, leadership exposure, and expanded scope.

 - Transparent Compensation: The compensation and equity framework is fully published, and recruiters and managers can clearly explain it to candidates and employees.

 - Automated Workflows: Routine HR tasks are largely automated or AI-driven, freeing up time to focus on talent strategy.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8–12 Years of Experience: Strong background in business operations or program management, with a track record of personally designing and launching programs that improved company performance standards. Prior HR experience is a nice to have, if you come from a top talent-density company.

 - End-to-End Execution: Experience launching major company-wide initiatives from initial concept to completion, both independently and with technical specialists.

 - Connected Talent Mindset: Ability to see hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation, and offboarding as one continuous loop, with clear examples of how you've fixed broken steps in that process before.

 - Process Optimization: Proven ability to organize unstructured processes into clear, repeatable routines with defined owners, deadlines, and metrics.

 - Practical AI & Automation Experience: Hands-on experience building or deploying AI and automation tools to eliminate manual administrative work.

 - Data & Tech Proficiency: Able to build and analyze metric dashboards, configure HR software, specify integrations, and troubleshoot data discrepancies.

 - People Management: Experience managing teams of five or more people, including directly resolving performance issues.

 - High-Growth Environment: Experience working in fast-paced, technology-driven companies where headcount and processes scaled rapidly.
   
   


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

 - You prefer delegating execution entirely to others; this role directly handles foundational tasks like handbooks, compliance training, internal communication, and monthly metric decks.

 - You expect a pre-made plan or roadmap rather than creating one from scratch.

 - You are uncomfortable speaking directly about performance gaps or talent quality issues.

 - You require a large team or pre-existing enterprise infrastructure to deliver results.

 - You are looking for a traditional HR or People role.

No matter the location, or the role, every Veho teammate shares one galvanizing mission: driving commerce forward with a customer-centric delivery experience that's built for the modern era. We live by our leadership principles. jobs.description:
ABOUT VEHO

 

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone. 

 

We are building a modern, end-to-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers.  

 

Powered by next-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post-purchase experience. We make delivery the ‘extension of the brand’ and leverage it to create deeper loyalty and trust between brands and their customers, driving customer retention and lifetime value. Our rapidly growing client list includes leading consumer brands like HelloFresh, Zara, Macy’s, Sephora, and more.

 

To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit-based culture. We seek team players who want to compete, win, make an impact and build a legacy, and we reward performance and impact players with generous equity and incredible career growth opportunities. 

About the Role

You'll be the operational backbone of Veho's global legal function—owning our SpotDraft platform configuration, workflow automation, and data integrity while partnering with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and IT to eliminate friction from contract execution. You'll translate business bottlenecks into technical solutions: designing metadata schemas that enable accurate reporting, building conditional routing logic that cuts contract cycle time, and integrating our CLM stack with Salesforce to eliminate manual handoffs. Your work directly accelerates deal velocity and ensures legal doesn't become a bottleneck as we scale across markets.



A Great Candidate

 - You have 3+ years in Legal Ops, Sales Ops, or Revenue Ops at a multinational or high-volume environment—you've actually debugged CLM platforms and know where contract processes break down, not just read documentation.

 - You've administered SpotDraft (or Ironclad, LinkSquares) at scale—backend configuration, custom fields, approval workflows, conditional logic—and can speak fluently about schema design and data governance decisions you've made.

 - You're fluent in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) and comfortable being the operational bridge between Bogotá-based legal and distributed international teams; you understand what gets lost in translation and prevent it.

 - You've built dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or Looker Studio (or advanced Sheets/Excel) that actually moved the needle—you know which KPIs matter (contract cycle time, approval bottlenecks, spend variance) and can make them visible and actionable.

 - You've configured Salesforce or HubSpot integrations or understand GTM tech stack architecture deeply enough to identify where manual data entry is causing friction and then fix it.

 - You've used no-code/low-code platforms or generative AI tools to automate repetitive work—you see Excel-based processes and instinctively think "this shouldn't require human hands."

 - You have experience with e-billing platforms, vendor compliance platforms, or third-party risk management—you've actually tracked spend against policy, caught overbilling, or ensured compliance checks happen before contracts execute.

 - You're organized and detail-oriented in a way that shows in your work—you own data audits without prompting, flag inconsistencies, and document decisions so others can follow your logic and scale your solutions.



What You'll Do

 - Own SpotDraft as the core platform administrator—configure custom metadata fields, schema tags, and conditional routing logic to match our business metrics and ensure 95%+ data accuracy across contract records.

 - Design and build approval workflows and dynamic routing rules that reduce contract turnaround time—eliminate manual triage by automating intake-to-first-review pathways and reducing legal team admin overhead by quantifiable hours per week.

 - Champion and deploy AI-powered tools (using generative AI platforms and no-code automation) to streamline contract intake, automate repetitive legal tasks, and measure adoption and time savings across the legal team.

 - Optimize integrations between SpotDraft, DocuSign, and Salesforce to eliminate manual data entry and handoffs—ensure contract data syncs accurately and establish monitoring to catch misalignment.

 - Administer our third-party risk and vendor compliance platform—execute background checks and compliance screening before contract execution, track completion against SLAs, and flag risk items for escalation.

This requires a high degree of business acumen, strategic thinking, problem-solving, understanding of operations, cross-functional partnership, and an entrepreneurial mindset. The Client Success Manager will create value for Veho’s clients by delivering on our commitments and innovating new product or service offerings to meet their transportation needs. jobs.title: Revenue Marketing Director
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEHO

 

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone. 

 

We are building a modern, end-to-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers.  

 

Powered by next-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post-purchase experience. We make delivery the ‘extension of the brand’ and leverage it to create deeper loyalty and trust between brands and their customers, driving customer retention and lifetime value. Our rapidly growing client list includes leading consumer brands like HelloFresh, Zara, Macy’s, Sephora, and more.

 

To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit-based culture. We seek team players who want to compete, win, make an impact and build a legacy, and we reward performance and impact players with generous equity and incredible career growth opportunities. 




THE ROLE

Veho has an incredible product-market fit, a product that clients, consumers, and driver-partners genuinely love, and a massive market in front of us. The opportunity now is to build the revenue marketing engine that matches that momentum.

We are hiring a Director of Revenue Marketing to own that engine end to end: the person responsible for turning market opportunity into consistent, predictable pipeline and, ultimately, revenue.

The challenge is simple: not every great-fit client is in market at the exact moment we want them to be. In a category with long buying cycles and big commercial decisions, winning means showing up long before the RFP, staying relevant while priorities shift, and being the obvious choice when a buyer is finally ready to move.

You will build the system that keeps Veho in front of the right accounts across paid media, nurture, referrals, ABM, retargeting, while creating new ways to generate demand now. You will decide where we invest, what we test, what we stop doing, and how Marketing, Sales, and RevOps operate together around one shared view of pipeline.

And you are not inheriting a finished machine. Some of the pieces exist; the full engine does not. You get to build it.

This is a rare chance to join a company with real momentum and shape how it goes to market at the moment when the foundation matters most. You will have the freedom to build, the commercial accountability to know whether it is working, and a product that clients, consumers, and driver-partners genuinely love.

The right person will find that incredibly energizing.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build the engine that captures Veho’s market opportunity. Own the strategy and execution across new-logo acquisition, nurture, referrals, paid media, ABM, retargeting, and conversion. Connect those pieces into one system designed to create consistent, predictable pipeline across our priority segments.

Create an always-on demand motion. Build the programs, sequencing, content, triggers, and experiences that keep Veho relevant before a prospect is ready to buy, then create clear paths from engagement to qualified pipeline when they are.

Generate pipeline, not activity. Work backward from SQOs, pipeline, and revenue to decide where Marketing should invest. Build a culture of experimentation across channels, scale what works quickly, and stop doing what does not.

Turn referrals into a growth channel. Take what has historically been informal or episodic and build a repeatable, always-on program with clear mechanics, incentives, ownership, and measurement.

Make paid media accountable to the business. Own our paid media strategy and agency relationship, including budget allocation, channel mix, testing, and performance. The standard is not clicks, impressions, or cost per lead; it is whether our investment creates qualified pipeline efficiently.

Build the operating rhythm with Sales and RevOps. Establish a shared cadence around MQLs, SQLs, SQOs, closed-won, and closed-lost performance. Create the attribution and reporting needed to understand what is creating pipeline, where prospects are getting stuck, and what we should do differently.

Build new motions from the ground up. Test new acquisition channels, lay the groundwork for account-based programs in priority verticals, and constantly look for the next scalable source of demand.

Use AI to make the engine smarter. Apply AI to targeting, segmentation, nurture, optimization, experimentation, and analysis. We are not interested in AI as a side project; we want someone who uses it to make better decisions and move faster every day.




WHAT YOU BRING

Experience

 - 7+ years across revenue marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or a related discipline

 - 2+ years owning a demand or revenue marketing function end to end, not simply managing a single channel

 - Experience building or materially rebuilding a demand engine in a high-growth B2B or B2B2C environment

 - Direct experience owning paid media strategy and managing agency relationships with clear, dollar-tied performance accountability

 - Experience partnering closely with Sales and RevOps around pipeline, attribution, funnel performance, and revenue

 - Experience marketing products with considered buying cycles where the majority of the market is not actively buying at any given moment

How you work

 - 0-to-1 builder. You have built the system before, not just inherited one and optimized it.

 - Commercial operator. You think in SQOs, pipeline, conversion, and revenue first; marketing activity metrics come second.

 - Systems thinker. You see paid, nurture, referrals, ABM, and conversion as parts of one connected engine and can quickly diagnose where it is breaking.

 - Mechanism designer. You can take something informal, inconsistent, or manual and turn it into a repeatable system with clear rules, ownership, and measurement.

 - Analytical. You are comfortable getting into the data, building attribution logic, and making investment decisions without waiting for an agency or dashboard to tell you what to think.

 - Structured experimenter. You test instead of debate. You move quickly, learn quickly, kill what does not work, and scale what does.

 - AI-forward. AI is already part of how you target, analyze, optimize, and execute. You can point to tangible ways it has made your work better.

 - Player-coach. You can set the strategy and still get deeply into the work yourself, especially while the function is being built.

 - Cross-functional influencer. You can align Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and senior leaders around a shared view of what is working, what is not, and what happens next.

 - High agency. You do not wait for perfect information or a fully written playbook. You make the call, move the work forward, and own the outcome.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Principal People Business Partner – Engineering & Product is a senior strategic partner to Veho’s Engineering and Product organizations, supporting a combined organization of approximately 75–100 employees. This role will partner closely with technical leadership to shape talent strategy, organizational design, workforce planning, and people-related business decisions while building scalable people practices that support Veho’s continued growth. The ideal person combines strong business acumen with deep People expertise and understands how high-performing Engineering and Product organizations operate. They will act as both a strategic advisor and hands-on builder, helping leaders strengthen their teams, develop talent, navigate organizational change, and maintain a high bar for performance and talent density.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Serve as the primary strategic People partner to Engineering and Product leadership, advising on talent strategy, organizational design, compensation, workforce planning, and other people-related business decisions.

 - Develop and execute talent strategies across Engineering and Product, including succession planning, capability building, retention, and strategic hiring.

 - Lead organizational design and restructuring efforts, identifying gaps, overlaps, and opportunities to improve team structure, collaboration, and execution.

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition to strengthen technical hiring strategies, leveling frameworks, interview processes, and overall hiring rigor.

 - Use people data and organizational insights to identify trends and make recommendations related to performance, engagement, retention, and organizational health.

 - Build and improve career architecture and progression frameworks for technical ICs, managers, and Product employees.

 - Develop and coach Engineering and Product managers, strengthening leadership capability around feedback, performance management, talent development, and team effectiveness.

 - Partner with Finance on compensation benchmarking, pay structures, and equity considerations for Engineering and Product talent.

 - Lead sensitive or complex people matters, including performance issues, leadership transitions, organizational changes, and escalated employee concerns.

 - Mentor other People Business Partners and create scalable playbooks and practices that strengthen the broader PBP function.

 - Leverage AI and emerging tools to improve People processes, surface insights, and increase the efficiency and scalability of the PBP function.
   
   


REQUIREMENTS

 - 8–12 years of experience across HR, People Operations, Organizational Development, or related People functions, including at least 5+ years in a strategic HRBP or similar advisory capacity.

 - Demonstrated experience directly partnering with Engineering and/or Product leadership on talent strategy, organizational design, and business-critical people decisions.

 - Experience working within a high-growth technology company or scaling tech-enabled organization, with comfort operating in fast-moving and resource-constrained environments.

 - Strong organizational design experience, including leading or supporting reorganizations, functional splits, team redesigns, or other significant structural changes.

 - Strong understanding of Engineering and Product organizations, including technical talent markets, organizational structures, hiring challenges, and career development.

 - Experience influencing and advising senior leaders, including the ability to challenge assumptions, navigate ambiguity, and have difficult conversations when necessary.

 - Demonstrated ability to build scalable People programs or practices from the ground up rather than simply administering established processes.

 - Strong analytical skills and experience using people data to inform organizational and talent decisions.

 - Experience developing managers and mentoring PBPs, HR partners, or other People leaders.

 - Strong change-management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions without direct authority.

 - Preferred: experience with technical hiring, compensation/equity strategy, early-stage or high-growth scaling, and/or logistics, supply chain, marketplace, or operational technology companies.
